description: This file defines an abstract class 'OA_Algorithm_Dependency_Source' which provides a base implementation for sources of hierarchical dependency data used in an algorithm. It includes methods for loading items, retrieving items and their IDs, checking for missing dependencies, and managing internal state.

classes.name: OA_Algorithm_Dependency_Source
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to load, access, and manage dependency items for hierarchical algorithms.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads items from storage into the source object, resetting internal state if already loaded.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Fetches and returns a specific item by its ID.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns all loaded items in order.

methods.name: getItemsIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of all loaded items.

methods.name: getMissingDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies among loaded items.

methods.name: checkLoaded
methods.description: Ensures data is loaded, performing load if necessary.

methods.name: _loadItemList
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses to load item list.
